title: McGraw Hill Expands Its AI-Powered ALEKS Product Portfolio
summary: New releases include ALEKS Adventure for Grades 4–5 and ALEKS for Calculus II Key Highlights: McGraw Hill is expanding its AI-powered ALEKS portfolio with ALEKS Adventure for Grades 4–5 and ALEKS for Calculus II. ALEKS Adventure now offers a complete K–5 experience, while ALEKS for Calculus II extends personalized support as students progress through the calculus sequence. ALEKS uniquely provides comprehensive assessment of a student’s knowledge from Kindergarten-level math through Calculus while using AI and learning science to personalize instruction and identify knowledge gaps. ALEKS has supported more than 65 million students for 25+ years and continues to see strong adoption across K–12 and higher education as demand grows for personalized supplemental and intervention math support.
